action.objective: Withdraw the attacked dark-squared bishop to h4, keeping it active and avoiding the h6 pawn advance's threat, while staying developed and ready to castle.
action.rationale: Bh4 is the only commit-ready move: exact score 14 at depth 3, no tactical refutation, no immediate mate. With h6 hitting the bishop, retreating is correct; Bxd3 is met by c2 recapture. Keeps activity and prepares castling.
